name: cluster-info-compare
description: Read ClusterCollector CRs from managed-cluster namespaces on OpenShift, store snapshots in PostgreSQL, and present a tile-based comparison UI

scripts.sync: node -e "require('./lib/db').initDb().then(() => require('./lib/sync').syncFromCluster()).then(r => { console.log(JSON.stringify(r, null, 2)); process.exit(0); }).catch(e => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); })"
